__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is six feet tall and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
chequered shirt.  His features are worn with hard work and his expression is
one of a peaceful man leading a simple life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: John the Lumberjack is here, looking for some trees to chop down.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle john lumberjack

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little thingies from toy shops at all.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A big, brown, angry-looking bear is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bear

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A ferocious rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rabbit

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes
looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle deer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick brush.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fox

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A vicious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle warg vicious

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle warg ferocious

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The large, grey wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large, grey wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wolf grey

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The large, black wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large, black wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wolf black

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon green

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This little fellow is only three foot tall with wild matted brown hair and long
tangled brown beard.  He wears ragged brown and green clothing and looks as if
he is having great fun.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Shargugh the Forest Brownie is here, grinning broadly at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shargugh brownie

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The druid looks quite old.  You would think him venerable, but you know
he would be a tough foe.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The elder druid is here ... he looks very upset at your presence in his home.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elder druid
